EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Spring Plankton Bloom
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Spring phytoplankton bloom fueled by increasing light and nutrient upwelling. Risk of oxygen depletion if bloom crashes.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Autumn Plankton Bloom
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Autumn bloom driven by nutrient remineralization and cooling waters. Higher crash risk due to shorter days reducing photosynthesis.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Plankton Bloom Crash
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Massive phytoplankton die-off triggers bacterial respiration spike. Dissolved oxygen crashes below 30% saturation causing acute fish mortality.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Storm Surge
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Severe storm causes wave damage to pen structures and stress-induced feeding reduction. Inspect pens for damage after.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Jellyfish Invasion
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Massive jellyfish bloom clogs pen nets and stings fish. Gill damage increases mortality and reduces feeding.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Marine Heatwave
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Extended period of unusually warm water temperatures. Growth accelerates but oxygen drops and disease risk spikes.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Arctic Cold Snap
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Sudden temperature drop below 2°C. Fish metabolism slows, feeding stops, growth halts. Risk of cold shock mortality.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Harmful Algal Bloom (HAB)
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Toxic algae species bloom. Neurotoxins accumulate in fish, making them unsellable. Immediate harvest or depuration required.

EnvironmentalEvents.Name: Oxygen Supersaturation Event
EnvironmentalEvents.Description: Photosynthesis-driven oxygen supersaturation (>150%). Risk of gas bubble disease in fish. Requires emergency aeration.
